The '''Max Rebo Fan Club''', which had [[Tik Tali Talosh]] as [[President/Legends|president]] of the group's [[Derf Chapter]], was a fan club dedicated to the [[Max Rebo/Legends|eponymous]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]].<ref name="SWI 67" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Max Rebo Fan Club was introduced in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article [[Rich Handley]] wrote for the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="SWI 67" /> which was published on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref>
